In Ethiopia, entrepreneur Hanan Ahmed is tackling period poverty and the stigma surrounding menstruation. By producing affordable reusable sanitary pads and raising awareness in schools, she hopes to make menstrual health more accessible and help girls stay in class. Report by Awa Diouf & Guillaume Gougeon.
